born.why: The code prioritizes survival by returning the safe option 'a4' when health (n1) is critically high (>80), preventing unnecessary risks that could lead to death, and only acting when it is safe enough or when default preference allows, thus keeping n1 lower and prolonging life.

The code prioritizes survival by aggressively stopping (a4) when danger (n1) is high or pending losses threaten immediate death, and only permits actions that do not increase danger when the agent is in a safer state.

The rewritten code prioritizes immediate survival at high n1, uses a threshold on n2 (current health) to switch between aggressive (a2) and conservative (a1) strategies to maintain lower average health, and approaches items only when the agent is in a stable mid-range zone.

The code prioritizes survival by enforcing a dynamic health buffer before allowing any action that reduces health (positive n2), and strictly avoids actions when health is critically low, thus preventing death while still permitting exploration in safe zones.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly refusing actions when n1 exceeds safe thresholds (95 for stop, 70 for caution) and checks item traits against current health to avoid risky items that could spike n1, ensuring the agent stays alive longer.

This code tightens the safety margins by triggering non-action ('a4') earlier (at n1>70 and trait>70) to prevent reaching the lethal n1=100 threshold, while still allowing acquisition when risks are low.
